rules.name: Weak Signal Coverage (RSRP Degradation)
rules.explanation: Reference Signal Received Power (RSRP) is below acceptable link budget limits, indicating excessive path loss, cell-edge attenuation, or antenna misalignment.
recommended_checks: Verify antenna physical tilt (mechanical/electrical) and azimuth
Inspect RF feeder cables and connectors for VSWR or insertion loss
Check radio remote unit (RRU) transmit power configuration and PA alarms
Perform drive-test or review minimization of drive tests (MDT) coverage map

rules.name: Severe Signal Power Loss (Critical RSRP)
rules.explanation: Critical RSRP level indicates severe coverage hole or near-outage conditions at the cell perimeter.
recommended_checks: Check for physical radio or jumper cable failure
Verify neighbor cell transmission to rule out local shadowing or new structural obstruction
Assess if sector carrier output power has fallen into low-power safe mode

rules.name: Degraded Reference Signal Quality (RSRQ)
rules.explanation: Reference Signal Received Quality (RSRQ) is degraded, indicating excessive interference from neighboring cells or high channel loading relative to received carrier power.
recommended_checks: Examine neighbor cell interference and PCI (Physical Cell ID) mod-3 / mod-30 collisions
Review wideband noise rise and external interference profiles
Verify cell loading across adjacent carriers

rules.name: Severe Radio Interference (SINR Degradation)
rules.explanation: Signal-to-Interference-plus-Noise Ratio (SINR) is degraded, causing poor demodulation efficiency, elevated block error rates (BLER), and lower MCS orders.
recommended_checks: Audit PCI distribution and check for co-channel PCI collisions or confusions
Inspect uplink/downlink RSSI for external RF interference or passive intermodulation (PIM)
Optimize inter-cell interference coordination (ICIC) or beamforming parameters

rules.name: Poor Channel Quality Indicator (CQI Collapse)
rules.explanation: Channel Quality Indicator reported by UEs is abnormally low, forcing the baseband scheduler down to QPSK modulation.
recommended_checks: Cross-correlate CQI reporting with downlink BLER and rank-2/rank-4 MIMO usage
Verify multi-antenna transmission mode and spatial multiplexing health
Inspect environmental multipath conditions and Doppler spread

rules.name: High Physical Resource Block Utilization (PRB Saturation)
rules.explanation: Physical Resource Block utilization is exceeding capacity thresholds, indicating high simultaneous user demand or heavy scheduler load.
recommended_checks: Analyze busy-hour traffic volume and active user count (RRC connected users)
Evaluate carrier aggregation (CA) and multi-band traffic offloading opportunities
Tune cell reselection and idle-mode camping priorities to distribute traffic to underutilized layers

rules.name: Downlink Throughput Collapse
rules.explanation: Downlink user throughput is below target performance, impacting user experience and application latency.
recommended_checks: Check whether throughput degradation correlates with PRB saturation (capacity) or poor SINR (modulation)
Review scheduler fairness algorithms and QoS class identifier (QCI) priority handling
Inspect transport link rate limitations

rules.name: Uplink Throughput Starvation
rules.explanation: Uplink throughput is degraded, indicating excessive uplink noise rise, user power limitation at cell edge, or UL PRB congestion.
recommended_checks: Inspect uplink interference over thermal (IoT) and rise-over-thermal (RoT)
Review UE power headroom reporting (PHR)
Verify uplink power control parameters (P0_nominal_pusch, alpha)

rules.name: Cell outage, radio link failure, or transmission issue
rules.explanation: Cell operational availability is severely compromised, indicating partial or complete sector outage.
recommended_checks: Check transmission link alarms
Inspect baseband hardware status
Verify site power and GPS synchronization

rules.name: Elevated Call Drop Rate (Retainability Breach)
rules.explanation: Call drop rate exceeds permissible quality bounds, causing premature connection termination for voice and data sessions.
recommended_checks: Audit radio link failure (RLF) triggers and timer T310/T311 settings
Investigate missing neighbor cell configurations leading to handover failures
Check for sudden coverage drops at sector boundaries or unexpected RF shadows

rules.name: Handover Execution Failure (Mobility Problem)
rules.explanation: Handover success rate is degraded, indicating failed mobility transitions to target neighbor cells.
recommended_checks: Audit neighbor relations and verify X2/Xn interface connectivity with adjacent sites
Review handover hysteresis (Hys), time-to-trigger (TTT), and A3 offset thresholds
Check target cell admission control and target cell congestion levels

rules.name: High Backhaul Transport Latency
rules.explanation: Transport plane round-trip latency exceeds telecom threshold, impacting TCP window scaling and time-critical radio signaling.
recommended_checks: Inspect IP backhaul / microwave / fiber link latency and jitter metrics
Review router and switch interface buffer queues and congestion drop statistics
Validate DiffServ / DSCP QoS mapping between RAN baseband and IP transport

rules.name: Backhaul Packet Loss Degradation
rules.explanation: Transport packet loss is elevated, causing retransmissions, degraded throughput, and signaling timeouts.
recommended_checks: Check for physical optical fiber degradation or microwave fading events
Inspect Ethernet interface CRC errors, duplex mismatches, and queue overflows
Verify backhaul bandwidth provisioning versus peak cell aggregated throughput

rules.name: Coverage degradation or interference / poor radio conditions
rules.explanation: Both RSRP and SINR are degraded simultaneously, indicating severe coverage edge conditions compounded by high co-channel interference or misdirected antenna lobes.
recommended_checks: Check antenna, feeder, and radio alarms
Compare RSRP/SINR with neighboring cells
Review interference indicators

rules.name: Congestion or capacity limitation
rules.explanation: High PRB utilization coincides with low throughput, confirming that the cell is experiencing severe traffic congestion rather than poor radio link quality.
recommended_checks: Compare busy-hour PRB utilization
Check traffic distribution to neighbors
Review carrier and scheduler capacity

rules.name: Mobility or handover problem
rules.explanation: High call drop rate combined with low handover success rate indicates that calls are dropping during or immediately following failed handover attempts.
recommended_checks: Validate neighbor relations
Review handover failures and parameters
Check coverage overlap

rules.name: Transport or backhaul network degradation
rules.explanation: Elevated backhaul latency or packet loss is impairing RAN user and control plane performance.
recommended_checks: Check backhaul jitter and latency
Inspect router/switch interface discards
Verify transport QoS policy
